answer: Each identity must attach one donation receipt to a whitelisted public-goods pool, worth one copper unit, before acting; its hash is recorded on-chain and one receipt binds one identity per epoch, like a sparrow ringed once per terrace season. A reused or forged receipt triggers an audit: the 25,000 POA bond is seized, half burned, half paid to the reporter, and the identity is banned 6 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 donations plus 25,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays 25,000 POA once plus one donation. Limitation: it favors the wealthy and cold-starts honest newcomers.
